entries.mem0ai/mem0: This universal memory layer provides multi-level state management for users, sessions, and agents through temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval. It is available as an Apache-2.0 self-hosted OSS SDK, a standalone server, or a managed cloud service.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: This AGPL-3.0 context database organizes agent memory as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs and a three-tier loading system. It achieves significant token reduction and task-completion gains while providing observable retrieval trajectories for debugging.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: This engine utilizes a custom vector graph and byte-level deduplication to sustain sub-300ms recall at scales exceeding 100B tokens per month. It features automated fact extraction and connects to external platforms like Google Drive, Notion, and GitHub for hybrid RAG search.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This agent brain utilizes a self-wiring knowledge graph with typed edges to provide synthesized answers complete with citations and gap analysis. It is designed for multi-user team environments through the use of scoped access controls.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: This memory system implements long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows across more than 25 LLM providers. It supports Python, Node.js, Go, and CLI clients for both hosted and self-hosted deployment configurations.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: This library provides a FastAPI server and client SDKs to build stateful agents with hybrid search and prompt-ready context injection. It serves as the upstream foundation for specialized self-hosted Hermes memory wrappers.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: Operating under the Elastic License 2.0, this provider manages context trees using git-like version control features such as commits, branches, and merges. It utilizes a five-tier retrieval system to achieve sub-100ms performance across 20 LLM providers.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: This zero-dependency system operates locally using a single SQLite database to provide sub-millisecond memory retrieval for Hermes Agents. It features episodic compression to ensure sub-linear storage growth and supports MCP for integration with tools like Cursor and Claude Code.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer system utilizes local infrastructure including Qdrant and Redis to manage persistent memory, structured facts, and an auto-curated wiki. It employs a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize specifically injected context during execution.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: This recursive harness uses outcome-gated promotion to manage context bundles and playbooks for complex agent tasks. It is available as a Python or TypeScript library and integrates with MCP clients and OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin implements a DAG-based context engine that uses a SQLite-backed store with FTS metadata to ensure no messages are lost. It builds depth-aware summary nodes in a hierarchical structure, allowing agents to search and expand compacted material.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This wrapper enables private cross-session persistence for Hermes Agent by providing a self-hosted backend for the Honcho library. It includes automated setup scripts for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis, supporting any OpenAI-compatible or local inference server.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first identity and memory layer provides portable state across Hermes Agent and other MCP clients. It achieves a 97.6% LongMemEval answer accuracy and supports data imports from Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur offers a shared memory layer for multi-agent systems that stores data locally as human-readable YAML engrams. It utilizes hybrid retrieval via BM25 and local embedders to integrate with tools like Claude Code and OpenClaw.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates entirely locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It employs hybrid retrieval, combining BM25 and vector search, to serve agents through MCP and dedicated plugins.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization tool accelerates inference by reordering and deduplicating blocks to maximize prefix reuse. It offers native plugin support for Hermes Agent, reducing prefill latency by 1.5–3× and saving up to 36% in token usage.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory provides durable, file-based long-term memory using a five-package plugin family that includes a dedicated Hermes adapter. The architecture relies on SQLite with FTS5 search rather than vector databases or embeddings.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin features explainable retrieval by tagging every recall with a 'why_retrieved' explanation. It supports an in-process embedded mode by default and includes recency ranking and contradiction tracking for multi-user environments.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack serves as a memory kernel stack that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory owner. It manages state using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to deliver purpose-built evidence packets to the agent for every query.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs to populate a local cache. Built for the Hermes 2026 Hackathon, it uses SQLite-vec and GGUF models to provide an MCP-native server for coding agents.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn establishes cross-project memory for coding agents by using a user's Obsidian vault as the primary source of truth. It stores memory as inspectable Markdown files and utilizes DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep provides reflective memory through semantic search, BM25 full-text indexing, and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for multimedia and codebases, using edge tags to create bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts to ensure agents load only necessary context. It uses local SQLite storage and offline embeddings to reduce prompt tokens by 94% while supporting profiles for Hermes and Cursor.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This utility reduces Hermes Agent prompt overhead by using local BM25 ranking to select relevant tool schemas. It is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0 and includes a dashboard to track estimated token savings.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes an embedded .lbdb graph database to manage agent memory with a built-in 1-10 importance ranking system. It prioritizes high-value information during context prefetch using BM25 keyword search and optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed layer provides a shared lifecycle kernel for Hermes and other agents to store durable context and decision logs in plain Markdown. It includes a migration workflow designed to convert chat archives into reviewable, version-controlled files.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: Focusing on episodic memory, this plugin features an on-demand summarizer and a trace.jsonl audit log for tracking all prefetch operations. It distinguishes itself by supporting immediate event deletion to ensure removed data does not persist in future recall.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables cross-session AI memory through pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots. It relies on a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox to manage tools for searching and updating agent state.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables Hermes agents to handle payments using USDC and stablecoins across EVM, Solana, and eight other chain families. It allows APIs to charge for access and agents to pay for services autonomously with a few lines of code.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local Markdown files, cron jobs, and MCP configurations to provide artifact search and retrieval capabilities. It offers five specialized tools and supports opt-in automatic tool-routing note generation via model calls.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin facilitates self-organizing long-term memory for Hermes agents. It includes configurable query expansion and result reranking to optimize the retrieval of manually stored or searched memories.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution provides AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval. It can be executed via native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon, featuring MinHash deduplication and metadata filters.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory by adding deterministic slash commands for searching and syncing repositories. It requires a local SourceVault server for indexing and provides LLM-callable tools for grounded Q&A.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search method that combines BM25, vector, and graph techniques. It also features automatic context checkpointing during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This file-based curation tool uses a git-backed directory to manage versioned Markdown memory without a database. It includes 'rot' and 'lint' curators to identify stale or conflicting data and proposes evidence-cited diffs for review.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a subagent-driven development methodology to enable autonomous task execution. It enforces technical rigor through red-green-refactor TDD and YAGNI principles while integrating with coding harnesses like Claude, Codex, and Cursor.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first design and prototyping system that provides CLI support for 26 executables, including Hermes Agent and DeepSeek Harness. It allows agents to export artifacts to formats like HTML and MP4 while utilizing a sandboxed iframe for live design previews.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This repository provides 817 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF 2.0, and AI RMF. The library is compatible with over 26 AI platforms to enhance agentic security capabilities.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee functions as a self-hosted knowledge graph engine that grants agents persistent long-term memory across sessions. It combines vector embeddings with graph-based reasoning and offers clients for Python, Rust, and TypeScript.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill enables agents to generate editable .drawio files from natural language descriptions using 11 diagram type presets. It includes self-check and auto-fix capabilities and can convert Mermaid text into diagram formats.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this skill facilitates natural-language mandates, ERC-7710 permissions, and x402 payments. It includes a master router and connector skills to manage escrow and dispute resolution.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to remove detectable AI patterns using a 112-entry word replacement table. It supports rewrite and edit-in-place modes across platforms including Hermes, Claude Code, and Cursor.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project uses an Agentic Evolver to automate skill deduplication and quality improvement across sessions. It synchronizes skill libraries across devices and teams, integrating with Hermes, Codex, and OpenAI-compatible APIs.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 12 metaskills that preserve state within a local directory for Claude Code and agentskills.io-compatible agents. These skills are delivered as spec-conformant plugins to ensure broad agent compatibility.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,153 professional agent skills in plain markdown format designed to run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It also provides ready-to-paste exports for other assistants like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Cursor.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set allows agents to perform video searches and extract transcripts, channel data, and playlists from YouTube. It is compatible with Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, and Windsurf, requiring a TranscriptAPI key for operation.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skill patterns. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, allowing users to manage detected patterns via slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate custom analytical instructions and thinking prompts for specific tasks. It includes pre-built domain lenses and reports findings alongside an analysis of potential blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This toolkit provides type-safe support for modular packages containing instructions, resources, and scripts for Pydantic AI. It utilizes progressive disclosure for prompt efficiency and supports both programmatic skills and remote registries.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This skill converts rough concepts into structured design documents and implementation handoffs using Lite or Full modes. It features a spec review gate that utilizes PASS/FAIL evaluation models to ensure project quality.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill implements literate programming by weaving prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files. It includes a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the primary documentation.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Designed for long-running agents, this harness manages tasks through a three-level work model and structured memory cards backed by files or SQLite. It provides a CLI for task management and facilitates cross-feature learning during execution.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin enables cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning tasks to replacement models.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Following the Agent Skills specification, this project provides interoperable skills for interacting with Chainlink services like CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds. It includes specialized integrations for CRE and ACE services within the oracle network.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This project offers a collection of skills, installation guides, and configurations specifically localized in Portuguese. It adheres to the agentskills.io standard and provides resources in the SKILL.md format.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This repository provides official prompting guidelines and API integration examples for FLUX.1 and FLUX.2 image generation models. It also features a specialized suite of six skills dedicated to FLUX 3 video generation.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts existing code repositories and developer documentation into version-pinned, agentskills.io-compliant skills. It ensures transparency by providing provenance through specific file and line number citations.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry facilitates the discovery and installation of reusable AI skills with support for recursive dependency resolution. It includes a Python client, a CLI, and commerce features powered by TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill manages complex, multi-step task execution with real-time progress tracking and autonomous decision-making. It ensures operational safety through built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures for recovery.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: This project introduces a four-verb YAML workflow language that audits permissions, costs, and types before execution. It generates hash-chained, tamper-evident receipts for every run and supports local LLMs through a single Rust binary.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes to manage files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts using standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during tool discovery. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incrementally discovers server metadata and schemas.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This retrieval skill employs a five-layer system including hard triggers, semantic embeddings, and RRF fusion to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. It is designed to reduce token usage and offers graceful degradation if specific dependencies are missing.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: A community hub for browsing and installing skills that implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This tool performs adversarial code reviews by deploying three parallel subagents to hunt for edge cases and exploits. It verifies findings through sandbox execution and incorporates deterministic pre-scans using tools like Semgrep and Bandit.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: An execution OS that uses a local SQLite database to manage habits and study blocks without cloud sync. It allows an agent to manage system design via the Model Context Protocol (MCP) while the user completes tasks.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across multiple interfaces, including Discord and Telegram, to reduce token usage by up to 80%. it supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project adapts verified procedures for task decomposition using mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It includes a systematic investigation protocol for causal debugging and a Python goal engine for persistent state management.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: A multi-agent skill that uses parallel sub-agents focused on hygiene, clarity, and correctness to simplify code in five programming languages. It features a tiered application process that includes a mandatory approval gate.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: A .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern that supports progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files. It integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based loading and automatically registers common skill directories.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This suite provides session management and worktree recovery to add persistent memory to agents like Claude Code. it orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and detects state drift caused by concurrent sessions.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This project provides a turnkey cybersecurity lab featuring 397 CVE-driven skills and 152 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and OWASP, to facilitate real exploits spanning 2015 to 2026.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible demo GIFs for repository READMEs using vhs or Playwright. It manages the entire pipeline from recording to optimizing files under 8 MB and embedding the final render.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This tool generates portable agent skills from plain language while preventing technical debt through a validator that detects frontmatter drift. It monitors official specifications weekly and uses CI-friendly exit codes to ensure skills remain spec-current.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server enables agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and is compatible with clients like Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses using protocols like Pay Link and x402. It is designed for compatibility with the agentskills.io standard and the Hermes Agent ecosystem.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: Skillseal provides a functional quality seal by testing agent skills for structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures to confirm a skill actually works.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This project enables deterministic path routing and Python runtime selection across native Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. It ensures compatibility by verifying existing project interpreters and routing file operations using environment-specific syntax.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring an account or API key. It includes tools for listing bounties and creating boards, with 85% of the payout going to the winning answer.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates multi-scale Chinese news briefings ranging from global to street-level perspectives. It utilizes semantic memory to integrate user interests and produces structured reports containing core conclusions and action suggestions.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This suite provides local OCR for privacy-focused document processing and video-to-text transcription from links or files. It also includes an e-commerce studio for batch material generation featuring brand overlays and AI text refinement.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This project exposes 191 tools via an MCP server to provide structured web data across 31 different platforms. It includes five production-grade workflow skills compatible with Hermes, Claude, Cursor, and other AI agents.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for various AI coding agents, including Hermes, to ensure reproducible environments. The packages are automatically updated on a daily basis to maintain parity with upstream releases.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: This repository offers scripts and configuration guides for running Hermes Agent and OpenClaw on ARM64 Android smartphones via Termux. It includes an automated installer for the Antigravity CLI and utilizes Termux:API and Termux:GUI for hardware and interface access.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This tool provides a one-line Termux command to install Hermes Agent on Android devices with support for over 200 AI models. It features a built-in gateway service to manage incoming connections directly from the mobile environment.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart enables Hermes Agent deployment on Kubernetes with a focus on single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both standard deployments and operator-ready workflows, including configurable gateway modes for API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings Hermes to both Android (via Termux) and iOS (via iSH) platforms. It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supports scheduled tasks through cron jobs on Android.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: This project implements hardware-enforced sandboxing for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell. It provides kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access alongside configurable security policies for web searches and messaging.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This repository provides a Docker-based sandbox image that bundles the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted directories and allows users to build specific versions of Hermes using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This NixOS module enables declarative deployment of Hermes Agent, including configuration for workspace documents and cli-config.yaml. It features a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix or systemd EnvironmentFiles for secure secrets handling.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for operating Hermes and OpenClaw agents across Docker and Kubernetes clusters. It tracks per-agent metrics and LLM budget caps while providing access through REST, CLI, and MCP interfaces.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: This Docker-first control plane manages multiple Hermes Agent instances with RBAC-controlled access and separate workspaces. It facilitates hierarchy-aware communication for inter-agent delegation and provides enterprise MCP access for external AI clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Designed for production-ready headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is optimized for autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs without a graphical interface.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: This portable distribution allows Hermes to run from USB drives or external storage without host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python 3.12 and rescue tools, supporting Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in isolated data environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework utilizes multiple LLM providers to deploy specialized agents for technical, sentiment, news, fundamental, and analysis tasks. It features a researcher team that assesses insights through structured debates.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This orchestration tool supports workflows for CrewAI, LangGraph, AutoGen, and other frameworks through a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API. It provides capabilities for task tracking, scheduling, and monitoring spend.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI and web dashboard for managing parallel coding agents, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It utilizes git worktrees for management and offers optional Docker or Podman sandboxing.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a tiered architecture and a task bus pattern to scale from single VPS agents to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for security auditing, registry management, and VPS setup.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This framework employs a level-based architecture and a task bus pattern to scale Hermes Agent from single agents to automated teams. It provides bundled skills for backup management, security auditing, and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework enables the construction of autonomous agent swarms using over 23 LLM providers. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts for team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to create, supervise, and review autonomous Hermes Agent work via a Kanban board. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and tool execution alongside human-in-the-loop verification.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure roles. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture governed by a Master Orchestrator for routing.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for automated task lifecycle management. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents representing two competing AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard for scoreboard metrics and code visualization.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack via parallel model querying and synthesis for local execution. It uses Hermes for task routing and tool-calling, optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080/5080.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that reduces token usage and tool calls for Hermes Agent. It features an MCP server for integration and automatically synchronizes the index whenever file changes occur.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI utility designed to track token consumption and associated costs across various AI coding agents, including Hermes. It offers a 3D visualization dashboard and allows users to submit their usage data to a public leaderboard.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables developers to inspect API traffic from Hermes Agent and other coding tools while automatically redacting authentication headers. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions to facilitate detailed debugging of agent interactions.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to help build better user interfaces with AI. It is compatible with Hermes Agent and any provider that supports markdown or general prompting.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time tracking of tokens, costs, and rate limits by reading the state of Hermes Agent and other CLIs directly. It supports multi-device synchronization, allowing users to monitor session details and account limits across different machines.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This project acts as an opinionated workflow layer that coordinates seven specialized agents to build and operate applications. It loads 36 skills and 6 workflows, supporting autonomous execution on both laptops and virtual private servers.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins allows users to customize the Hermes terminal UI with community-created themes, including retro DOS and cyberpunk aesthetics. It uses YAML-based configuration to modify visual elements such as banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This port brings the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills natively into the Claude Code Channel without requiring external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via the Signal Protocol. It supports human-readable identity handles and facilitates commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser built for autonomous agent control through the Model Context Protocol. It features a supervisor sidebar for managing workflows and includes an undo function to revert recent changes made by an agent.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory capabilities for platforms like VS Code and Slack using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It supports multiple frameworks, including CrewAI, LangGraph, and the Google ADK.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve up to 99% token savings during CLI workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for research, finance, and devops, featuring automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md provides a framework for creating scoped Hermes Agents that automatically switch between default and project-specific configurations based on the current folder. It enables the use of project-local memories, tools, and custom instructions to maintain context-specific agent behavior.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of the hermes-agent stack and 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It facilitates rapid setup with zero cost, supporting 29 community plugins categorized into six functional areas.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: Lintlang is a static linter that performs local, deterministic checks on agent configurations and tool descriptions without requiring API calls. It identifies issues like vague descriptions or missing stop conditions and supports SARIF and JSON outputs for CI/CD integration.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions OpenClaw environments to Hermes Agent by mapping SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and skills into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It also configures systemd gateway services and manages nested authentication structures during the migration process.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco offers self-healing observability for multi-agent systems through passive monitoring and active probing without cloud dependencies. It includes a native Hermes Agent plugin for real-time telemetry and establishes baselines by monitoring local configuration files.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled assistant adds offline, open-mic capabilities to Hermes Agent with support for wake words and barge-in functionality. It operates locally without API keys, supporting 35 languages via Piper and 9 via Kokoro.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Hermes-startup functions as a local-first skill that utilizes dynamic slash commands and a deterministic runtime to help users generate revenue. The tool prioritizes security by requiring explicit approval for any external actions or write operations.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built on the Tauri 2 framework, provides a unified interface for Windows, macOS, and Linux users. It centralizes configuration management for Hermes Agent alongside other CLI tools like Claude Code and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application that integrates external agents including Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It features built-in assistants for generating editable office documents and supports remote access through a WebUI or messaging platforms like Telegram.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: This interface runs the Hermes agent in-process using existing configurations and models, accessible via browser or mobile through secure SSH tunneling. The layout includes a three-panel workspace with integrated file browsing for direct interaction.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app simplifies the initial experience with guided installation and provider setup for Hermes Agent. It provides a graphical interface for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: Hermes Studio serves as a local control plane for managing profiles, credentials, and scheduled jobs across ten platform channels like WhatsApp and Slack. It distinguishes itself with a visual node-based workflow builder and integrated usage analytics.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex tasks. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and specialized managers for skills and MCP catalogs.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg aggregates sessions from fifteen ACP-compatible agents, including Hermes, into a collaborative workspace available as a desktop app or Docker container. It supports unattended review by executing concurrent tasks within isolated git worktrees.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool offers direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts with an embedded terminal for system repair. It organizes agent activity through native views for Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first application includes the Hermes-CN-Core kernel for local agent execution. The UI supports LaTeX and Mermaid rendering while providing dedicated management for MCP tools and memory.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium extension connects a local or remote Hermes runtime to the active browser context via a side-panel. It includes an MV3 controller for approved tab actions and site-aware drafting capabilities across 31 writing environments.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI app for iOS 18+ that pairs with a hermes-webui server to drive self-hosted agents from a phone. It allows users to manage sessions and skills while providing read-only access to agent memory and analytics.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines with custom LLM model routing. It features a runtime dashboard for tracking latency and token usage alongside a live workspace for monitoring code diffs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a comprehensive control plane for managing MCP server lifecycles and monitoring agent health via the ZOO Swarm Monitor. It features a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and real-time chat with tool call visualization to oversee the entire Hermes AI agent stack.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that aggregates searchable history from fifteen different coding agent CLIs into a single cockpit. It prioritizes privacy through local operation without telemetry while tracking per-session quota burn for Codex and Claude models.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It distinguishes itself by integrating a WebRTC voice mode powered by OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP for hands-free interaction.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and React 19, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web-based interface. It includes a specialized approval inbox designed specifically for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: This project offers a terminal-based alternative for managing Hermes Agent sessions using OpenTUI. It combines a TUI chat interface with a kanban board for task management, allowing users to handle profiles, skills, and cron jobs from the command line.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA designed for Telegram Mini App v2.0 that supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances. It secures local operations using dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication for Telegram validation.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This Windows desktop solution requires no installation, Docker, or admin rights to provide a GUI for local and cloud AI models. It features a dynamic tool maker for API and Python handlers alongside built-in support for ComfyUI workflows and TTS.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface that provides real-time log streaming and a task tracking dashboard for self-hosted AI assistants. It includes dedicated management tools for organizing skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers within a visual environment.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This monitoring-focused dashboard tracks session activity and costs in real-time while providing full inspection of conversation histories. It offers read-only visibility into environment variables and skill source code to ensure configuration oversight.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first workspace that utilizes tool approval cards and SSE streaming to manage agent interactions. It features an integrated marketplace for discovering MCP servers and supports isolated profile management for separate memory and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This desktop client coordinates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents managed by a PM orchestrator. It includes a visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports native model switching with streaming responses.
